newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index edges higher.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index edges higher.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was 0.12 points or 0.15 percent higher on Friday at 79.46, after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index rose 30.16 points to a provisional 3,522.81.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was lower at 16.33 percent from 17.34 percent Thursday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
